message.content:
A typical medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal** (about 18 kcal per 100 g).  
If you’re looking at a small tomato (≈80 g) it’s closer to 15 kcal, and a large one (≈180 g) can be around 30–35 kcal.  

So, for most everyday purposes you can round to **20–25 kcal per medium tomato**.
